content.title: React Compiler: A complete guide - LogRocket Blog
How fast is the React Compiler? - DebugBear

results: React Compiler is a build-time tool that automatically memoizes React components and hooks. According to the React docs and a LogRocket guide, it removes most manual useMemo and useCallback calls; DebugBear measured faster interactions on real apps.
